name: intro
spoken: Tyk five sixteen adds API Fragments: configuration you store once and share across many APIs.

name: problem
line1: Monday: a new partner goes live
line2: NovaPay must call four Meridian Bank APIs from the browser | The CORS rules live in one Fragment, not in four APIs
spoken: Meridian Bank has a new partner, NovaPay, whose web app must call every Meridian API. The allowed origins live in one Fragment.

name: blocked
line1: NovaPay's web app calls four APIs through Tyk Gateway
line2: Today the browser blocks every one
spoken: Today NovaPay is not an allowed origin, so the browser blocks all four calls.

name: manager
line1: Fragments have their own screen in Tyk Dashboard
line2: Each one is a named piece of shared API configuration
spoken: Fragments have their own screen in the Dashboard, under Assets.

name: usage
line1: The Fragment lists every API that uses it
line2: Four APIs reference this one CORS policy
spoken: Each Fragment lists the APIs that reference it. Four APIs share this CORS policy.

name: edit
line1: Add the partner's origin to the Fragment
spoken: The platform team adds NovaPay's origin once, and saves.

name: allowed
line2: All four APIs now accept NovaPay
spoken: Reload the partner app. All four APIs now accept it. No API was edited or redeployed.

name: badge
line1: API teams see what is shared, and who sets it
line2: The setting is read-only inside the API
spoken: In each API, the shared setting is marked and read-only, with the Fragment that sets it.

name: guard
line1: A change that would break the APIs
line2: Tyk checks every API first and refuses the save
spoken: Now a mistake: a value of the wrong type. Tyk checks every API that uses the Fragment and refuses the save.

name: still
spoken: Nothing was saved, and the partner app still works.

name: verdict
line1: Store it once. Change it once.
line2: One Fragment, four APIs, one edit | A breaking change is refused before it reaches the Gateway
spoken: One Fragment, four APIs, one edit. And a breaking change is refused before it reaches the Gateway.
